decision: Public v1.33.0 made Blanc Spaces free for everyone, and Blanc Patron became optional support that unlocks nothing (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-blanc-spaces-redesign-design.md). The support answers that described Patron as adding Blanc Spaces, its creation gate and its lapse rules are reworded to that decision; pricing, Polar and the founding licenses are unchanged. Applied after docs/website-blanc-spaces-rename-2026-10-11.json.

supportAnswers.before: Browsing essentials and ordinary tab groups are free. Blanc Patron is the optional subscription: US$30 per year or US$4 per month, plus applicable tax. It adds saved Blanc Spaces. Creating a space requires an active Patron subscription. If membership lapses, existing spaces remain openable, switchable, and automatically updated. Renaming and removing existing spaces continue to work if it lapses. Earlier one-time supporters keep their lifetime Patron access.
supportAnswers.after: Blanc Patron is the optional subscription: US$30 per year or US$4 per month, plus applicable tax. It is how you support Blanc’s development, and it unlocks nothing: every feature, including Blanc Spaces, is free for everyone. Earlier one-time supporters keep their lifetime Patron access.

supportAnswers.before: Blocking, private tabs, favorites, ordinary tab groups, Quiet Tabs and optional encrypted Sync remain free. Patron does not restrict access to the open-source code.
supportAnswers.after: Blocking, private tabs, favorites, tab groups, Blanc Spaces, Quiet Tabs and optional encrypted Sync are free. Patron does not restrict access to the open-source code.
